title: A small web system
summary: A fictional web application: the browser asks the API for records stored in a database.

lanes.label: Client
lanes.summary: The user-facing browser that starts the request.

lanes.label: Application
lanes.summary: The API boundary that validates requests and reads records.

lanes.label: Storage
lanes.summary: Persistent records read by the application.

nodes.label: Browser
nodes.summary: The user interface sends an HTTPS request to the API.

nodes.label: API
nodes.summary: Validates the request, reads records, and returns JSON.

nodes.label: Database
nodes.summary: Stores records. This request reads data without changing it.

edges.label: HTTPS
edges.summary: The browser requests the latest records.

edges.label: Read query
edges.summary: The API reads records from the database.

flows.title: Load records
flows.summary: One successful request, from the browser to the database and back.

messages.label: GET /records
messages.note: The browser requests the record list.

messages.label: Read records
messages.note: The API runs a read-only query.

messages.label: JSON response
messages.note: The API sends the records back to the browser.
